name: The Okinawa Electric Power Company, Incorporated
summary: The Okinawa Electric Power Company, Incorporated engages in the generation, transmission, and distribution of electricity in Okinawa Prefecture, Japan. It operates through two segments: the Electric Power Business and Construction Business segments. The company generates electricity from thermal sources. It also offers civil engineering, architectural, electrical, plumbing, piping and telecommunications works, as well as construction and maintenance of power equipment.
